spell_error.isekai_mahou.element_not_awa: You haven't awakened %s yet (a spell's element comes from its glyphs).
message.isekai_mahou.loadouts_migrated: Isekai Mahou 1.0: your spells were reorganized into %s loadouts (Alt + scroll, Mouse 5 + scroll or Alt + 1–9). Each spell's element now comes from its glyphs.
message.isekai_mahou.loadouts_migrated_p: %s spell(s) that didn't fit the loadouts became Presets (see the Grimoire).
message.isekai_mahou.training.at_ceiling: %s training: your limit is already at this level's ceiling — level up to train further.
message.isekai_mahou.training.daily_done: %s training: you already trained %s times today. Your body needs rest until tomorrow.
message.isekai_mahou.training.gain: %s training: limit +%s (now %s of %s). Trainings today: %s/%s. Regeneration reduced for 60 s.
message.isekai_mahou.preset.empty: You can't save an empty preset.
message.isekai_mahou.preset.full: Presets full (%s). Delete one to save another.
message.isekai_mahou.preset.rename_faile: Invalid name or already used by another preset.
spell_info.isekai_mahou.copies_note: %s of the cost comes from copies (per-copy cost).
spell_info.isekai_mahou.copies_warning: Warning: %s of the cost comes from copies — every copy pays its effects and their augments again.
glyph.isekai_mahou.repair.desc: Repairs the target's gear (both hands and armor) by 12% of each piece's durability, more with Amplify. Build "Self + Repair" to fix your own.
command.isekai_mahou.mastery.none: No glyph mastery yet. Use your spells in combat or work.
isekai_mahou.configuration.channelAura: Aura while meditating or holding a long cast
isekai_mahou.configuration.channelAura.t: Subtle threads of light around whoever meditates or holds a cast for over a second. Turn off if it bothers you.
message.isekai_mahou.mastery.legend: ✦ %s took mastery of %s to level %s. Something in the world shifts.
command.isekai_mahou.mastery.curve_heade: Mastery curve (endless; the saved number stops at level %s):
command.isekai_mahou.mastery.curve_line: • %s — %s total XP (~%s enemy hits) · +%s%% effect · −%s%% cost
mastery.isekai_mahou.family.support: support piece (no mutations: it only gets cheaper)
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.halo.desc: the magic circle gains a rune ring and its colour starts to shift (spell average).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.cosmic.desc: stars orbit you and the circle turns cosmic blue (spell average).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.cosmic.hint: there are stars where there shouldn't be.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.eldritch.desc: a second, sickly green circle spins backwards with a wave of darkness (spell average).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.eldritch.hint: something on the other side is watching.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.eclipse.desc: on cast, the sky darkens for a moment for everyone nearby (every 10 s).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.quake.desc: casting shakes the ground for everyone around (every 5 s).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.quake.hint: the ground can't take much more.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.singular.desc: a pillar of white light tears the sky on every cast (every 5 s).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.fragment.desc: a ghost projectile flies alongside, slightly off to the side (30% power).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.echo.desc: 1.5 s later the spell repeats itself from the same spot (35% power, free).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.echo.hint: do you hear your spell twice?
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.fragment_2.desc: two ghost projectiles, one on each side.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.swarm.desc: three ghost projectiles in a fan.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.echo_3.desc: the spell repeats TWICE (1.5 s and 3 s later).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.aftershock.desc: where the area hits, an aftershock bursts right after (20% damage, enemies only).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.aftershock.hint: the impact doesn't end where it ends.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.vortex.desc: enemies around the hit are pulled to the centre (not bosses).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.area_echo.desc: 1.5 s later the spell repeats itself (35% power, free).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.singularity.des: the vortex becomes huge (8 blocks) and much stronger.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.pulse.desc: on cast, a wave pushes enemies within 3 blocks away (no damage).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.pulse.hint: the air around you grows heavy.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.reveal.desc: enemies within 12 blocks glow for 4 s (every 5 s).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.pulse_2.desc: the pulse reaches 5 blocks and slows enemies.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.abyss_pulse.des: 7 blocks, strong push and Slowness II.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.heavy.desc: hits shake the screen of anyone nearby.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.arc.desc: damage jumps to the nearest enemy (25%).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.residue.desc: leaves an elemental trace on the ground that hurts enemies 3 times (8% each).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.residue.hint: the ground keeps a little of the magic.
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.rupture.desc: whoever dies to the effect bursts and hurts enemies around (50%).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.blessing.desc: you and allies within 6 blocks get Regeneration for 3 s (every 10 s).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.aegis.desc: with the blessing, Absorption for 5 s (every 20 s).
mastery.isekai_mahou.mut.grace.desc: the blessing also grants Resistance for 3 s.
